transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been having some trouble with eating. It's mostly at night, when I'm alone. I'll start eating, and then... it just feels like something takes over. I can't stop. Even when I'm literally telling myself to put the food away, I just keep going. It's really out of my control.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating?

Yeah, I do. The guilt is pretty intense. After I eat like that, I usually end up in the bathroom making myself throw up. It just feels like the only way to undo it, you know? Like I have to get it out before the calories actually settle in.
How often do these episodes of eating happen?

I'd say it's been going on for... at least the last four months. It's usually at least one night a week where I just end up eating way more than I meant to when I'm alone. And then, yeah, I make myself throw up afterward.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

Pretty much every time. If I have one of those nights where I lose control and eat too much, I always make myself throw up right after. I don't think I've ever just... kept it down after eating like that. So it matches up exactly with the eating, about once a week.
Do you worry about gaining weight?

Yeah, constantly. It's always on my mind. Like, if I step on the scale after a shift at the clinic and it's even just a pound higher, or if my work pants feel a little tighter than usual, I just... I spend the whole day obsessing over it. I start worrying that I'm letting myself get fat, and right away I start planning out how I'm going to make up for it so I don't gain anything.
Have you ever had episodes where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop, but didn't make yourself throw up afterward?

No, I don't think so. Like I was saying a minute ago, if I lose control and eat a ton of food like that, I... I can't just let it sit there. I always make myself throw it up afterward. I don't think there's ever been a time where I just ate like that and kept it all down.
How many times a month would you say you have one of these episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you can't stop?

Well, like I mentioned, it happens about once a week. So I guess that would be roughly four times a month. It's been going on like this for at least the last four months... usually one night a week where I'm alone, I eat way more than I planned, and then I make myself throw up.
Have you ever used laxatives or diuretics to try to undo the effects of one of these eating episodes?
No, I haven't ever used anything like that. I don't take laxatives or water pills or anything. When I need to... you know, undo it, I just make myself throw up. That's the only thing I do.
Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop, but didn't make yourself throw up or use any other method to undo it?
No, like I said a minute ago, I've never done that. If I eat a huge amount of food like that, I always throw it up. I've never just kept it down.

Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop, and also didn't make yourself throw up afterward, but this happened more than once a month?

No, I haven't. Like I was just saying, if I have one of those episodes where I eat a lot and feel out of control, I always make myself throw up. I've never just had the eating part without doing that afterward.
Have you ever had more than one episode in a week where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop?

Yeah, definitely. For at least the last four months or so, there's usually been at least one night a week where I'm alone and I just... I end up eating way more than I meant to. And like I said, I always make myself throw up afterward.
Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop, and you didn't make yourself throw up afterward?

No, I... I feel like you just asked me this. Like I've been saying, no. Every single time I eat that much and feel out of control, I always make myself throw up. There hasn't been a time where I didn't do that.
Do you typically feel a significant decrease in guilt or anxiety after making yourself throw up?

I'm not really sure. I mean... I do it because I feel like I have to get rid of all that food, but I don't know if the guilt actually goes away. Honestly, I usually still feel pretty bad about the whole thing afterward... just maybe in a different way. I wouldn't say the anxiety just disappears.
Have you ever had more than one episode in a month where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop, but didn't make yourself throw up afterward?

I... again, no. Like I just said, I always throw up after I eat like that. It doesn't really matter if we're talking about a week or a month. If I lose control and eat a huge amount of food, I make myself sick every single time. There just aren't any times where I don't do that.
Have you ever had a month where you had more than four episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop?

I'm not really sure about the exact number. I don't... I don't keep a tally of it or anything. I mean, it definitely happens, but I couldn't tell you if it's been more than four times in a single month. I just haven't really tracked it like that.
Have you ever had a period where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop and didn't make yourself throw up, and if so, how often did that happen?

I think... well, like I mentioned just a minute ago, I don't really have times like that. If I eat a huge amount of food and feel like I can't stop, I always make myself throw up afterward. There hasn't been a period where I just ate like that and didn't do anything about it. It's always followed by making myself sick.
Have you ever had a month where you didn't make yourself throw up after eating a large amount of food in a short time without being able to stop?

No... I mean, like I've been saying, no. That just doesn't happen with me. If I lose control and eat a ton of food like that, I always make myself throw up. There's never been a month, or really even a single time, where I didn't do that.
